segments.text:
V. 1.
Then ſhall the kingdom of heaven—That is, the Candidates for it, Be like ten virgins—The Bride Maids on the Wedding Night, were wont to go to the Houſe where the Bride was, with burning Lamps or Torches in their Hands, to wait for the Bridegroom's Coming. When he drew near, they went to meet him with their Lamps, and to conduct him to the Bride.
